subject: densityplot_ changing line type of each graph plotted inside one plot

messages.author: 159ac5a66c80c1d5
messages.subject: densityplot_ changing line type of each graph plotted inside one plot
parts:
currently I have a 2 density plots (separated by facet_grid), the first contains 3 different lines (plots) and the second contains 2.

At present the alpha means that each line has a fill of a different colour.

I would however like to turn all of these colours off (alpha=0)

AND THEN ... have a different line type or line hatching fill for each of the different lines (as the graphics must be in black and whit ebt still distinguish between the different line plotted).

This is what I have so far:

ggplot(histogrameg, aes(log(Total_scale+1), fill=Parameter)) + geom_density(alpha = 0) +xlab("Log (Total study scale+1)") +ylab("Proportion of studies") + facet_grid(~Typepara)

if I use lty in the geom_density command e.g.

geom_density(alpha = 0, lty=1)

then obviously all of the lines of all of the plots come out the same (with line type 1).

when trying to use a combindation of line types:

geom_density(alpha = 0, lty=c(1:5))

I get told I can only use one ("When _setting_ aesthetics, they may only take one value. Problems: linetype")

I however need to have them so each has its own line type (which was previously done with colours from fill=Parameter)

Thanks for the help in advance!


p.s. this is what my data looks like

  Parameter Total_scale  Typepara
     prey        0.04         Biotic
     prey       17.20        Biotic
     Depth       35.56     Abiotic
     Depth       40.50     Abiotic
     Depth      161.54    Abiotic

You can use Parameter just like that :) aes(linetype=Parameter) if
Parameter is discrete or a factor.
